description.en: Creates a secondary/sub telop caption linked to an avatar name-tag telop (see CMND_2DO_CREATE_AVA_TELOP), e.g. a smaller line of text under a pet/avatar's name. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation and its similarity to CMND_2DO_CREATE_AVA_TELOP.
Internal name to register the sub-telop under.
Name of the parent avatar telop this sub-telop is attached to.

example.code:
// Create a sub-caption attached to an avatar's name telop
CMND_2DO_CREATE_AVA_SUB_TELOP("petSub", "petName", 0, 10, 14, "Lv.5", 80, 6);
